results.name: correlated exists by outer id
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE EXISTS (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE orders.user_id = outer.id AND amount >= 20) ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT u.id AS id FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.amount >= 20) ORDER BY u.id

results.name: expr composed cast nullif
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE CAST(amount AS INT) >= 20 AND NULLIF(status, 'draft') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE CAST(amount AS INT) >= 20 AND NULLIF(status, 'draft') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

results.name: not in subquery paid users
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid') ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid') ORDER BY id
